casino.help.blackjack:
Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Face cards count as 10; an ace counts as 1 or 11.
Hit takes a card. Stand ends your turn. Double is available with two cards: pay another stake, draw exactly one card, then stand.
Dealer hits below 17 and stands on 17, including soft 17.
Total payouts: win 2x; two-card blackjack 2.5x (3:2 profit); tie 1x; loss 0. Dealer blackjack beats all hands except another blackjack. Stakes must be even.
Last stake copies the amount. Bet still confirms participation.
casino.help.poker:
Texas Hold'em begins with at least two players and two private cards each. Preflop, flop (3 community cards), turn and river (1 each) have betting rounds. The best five of seven cards win.
Check with nothing owed. Call pays the amount owed, limited to your stack. Raise chooses your total bet for this street. Fold leaves the hand. All-in bets your whole table stack; short all-ins do not always reopen raising.
Current blinds: small %2$s / big %3$s. Heads-up, the dealer pays the small blind.
Hands weakest to strongest: high card, pair, two pair, three of a kind, straight, flush, full house, four of a kind, straight flush (royal flush is highest).
Side pots, split pots and returned uncalled bets are included in your personal payout. Payout enters your table stack. Buy-in is not a hand stake. Leaving cashes out the remaining stack after the hand. Private cards remain private.
casino.help.roulette:
European roulette has 37 numbers, 0 to 36. Zero is green and loses every outside bet.
Total payout including stake: single number 36x; dozen or column 3x; red/black, even/odd and 1-18/19-36 each 2x.
Up to twelve personal bets. During betting, click a personal bet to remove and refund it. All bets opens the complete list.
Last bets repeats your combination from your previous played round after validating all bets together. A failed repeat charges nothing. No automatic play.
Your result totals all personal bets and payouts.
casino.help.wheel:
Twelve equally sized segments: six 0x, three 1x, two 2x and one 4x.
The multiplier is the entire chip payout including stake. 0x loses all; 1x returns your stake; 2x and 4x pay those total multiples. The highlighted segment under the pointer is the result.
A physical wheel allows one spin at a time. The next stake is possible after settlement.
Last stake only copies the amount. Spin confirms and pays for participation. No automatic repeat.
casino.help.exchange:
Current rate: 1 diamond = %1$s chips, in both directions. Quantity buttons count diamonds or whole exchanges. Max considers items and inventory space.
Spendable chips are in the 36 main inventory slots. Stored balance must be collected first and never automatically pays a stake.
Exchanges are atomic. Without enough space nothing is consumed. Collection only delivers chips that fit; the rest remains stored.
Existing automatic win delivery is preserved. Excess remains a safe claimable balance. History is session-only and contains no cards.
